2104171696726929453: Deepening and strengthening the life of faith within families is key to resolving many of the crises facing the Church and society. It is within families that we learn how to live together, respect others, accept diversity, support one another, be generous, give of ourselves freely, and embrace the spirit of sacrifice. Perhaps this is our main challenge: that Jesus may live fully in the families of French Catholics and illumine them with His presence. #ApostolicJourney #France
